items.title: Mary Heilmann Dies at 86
items.summary: Plus: Dean Millien's aluminum-foil animal world, another museum heist in Europe, and the architect leading a new Chinese vernacular.

items.title: Mary Heilmann, Painter of Irreverent Abstractions, Dies at 86
items.summary: “My inspiration for art doesn’t really come from the history of painting,” the artist told Hyperallergic in a 2013 interview, “it comes from the community of art as it is now.”

items.title: NYC Names Bryan Joseph Lee as New Deputy Culture Commissioner
items.summary: The cultural strategist and producer will work alongside curator and commissioner Diya Vij at the Department of Cultural Affairs.

items.title: Dean Millien’s Aluminum-Foil Animal World
items.summary: A highlight of “Greater New York” at MoMA PS1, the artist’s remarkable sculptures made from the humble household material continue a practice he began as a child in Brooklyn.
